nodes.description: address public constant WETH (0xC02aaA...756Cc2) mainnet wrapped ether address used as quote token in Uniswap pair lookups.
address public constant PHNX (0x38A2fD...F2f7) the protocol token whose price is derived.
address public constant UNISWAP_V2_FACTORY (0x5C69bE...aA6f) the Uniswap V2 factory address.
IUniswapV2Factory storage reference set in constructor; used for getPair lookups.
mapping(address=>uint256) public cummulativeAveragePrice storing the token cumulative price snapshot.
mapping(address=>uint256) public cummulativeEthPrice storing the ETH/WETH cumulative price snapshot.
mapping(address=>uint32) public tokenToTimestampLast storing the pair blockTimestampLast from getReserves.
mapping(address=>uint256) public cummulativeAveragePriceReserve storing the raw priceXCumulativeLast reserve value.
mapping(address=>uint256) public cummulativeEthPriceReserve storing the complementary raw cumulative reserve value.
mapping(address=>uint32) public lastTokenTimestamp set to uint32(block.timestamp) inside setValues.
Oracle constructor: instantiates factoryInterface from UNISWAP_V2_FACTORY and calls setValues(PHNX).
public setValues(address token): resolves the WETH/token pair, reads Uniswap cumulative prices and reserves, orders them by token address and records block.timestamp.
external override fetch(address token) returns a price; refreshes stale values based on block.timestamp and computes ethPerToken*1e18/ethPerPhnx with SafeMath.
external override fetchPhnxPrice(): refreshes PHNX values if stale and computes the PHNX-per-ETH price via _calculate using elapsed time.
internal view _getAmounts(address token): resolves the pool, computes timeElapsed from stored timestamps and delegates to _calculate.
public view _calculate(latestCommulative, oldCommulative, timeElapsed, token): builds a FixedPoint price by dividing the cumulative delta by timeElapsed and scaling by token decimals.
Miner/validator-influenced block timestamp used for staleness checks, timeElapsed computation and stored as uint32.
External call to the Uniswap factory getPair(WETH, token) returning a pool address that is implicitly trusted.
External view calls to IUniswapV2Pair price0CumulativeLast/price1CumulativeLast/getReserves on an untrusted pool address.
External call to IERC20(token).decimals() on an attacker-controlled token address inside _calculate.
Arithmetic division of the cumulative price delta by timeElapsed; reverts/undefined when timeElapsed is zero and overflow is desired in the Uniswap math (see code comments).
address token parameter of setValues used to look up the pair.
address token parameter of fetch whose price is computed.
address token parameter of _getAmounts used for pool lookup and _calculate.
uint256 latestCommulative parameter of _calculate (newest cumulative price).
uint256 oldCommulative parameter of _calculate (previous cumulative price).
uint32 timeElapsed parameter of _calculate used as divisor.
address token parameter of _calculate whose decimals() is queried.
address pool local holding the factory getPair result in setValues.
uint256 ethPerPhnx local in fetch computed via _getAmounts(PHNX).
uint256 ethPerToken local in fetch computed via _getAmounts(token).
uint256 price local/return value in fetch.
address poolAddress local result of factoryInterface.getPair in _getAmounts.
uint32 timeElapsed local in _getAmounts derived from stored timestamps.
FixedPoint.uq112x112 priceTemp local built from the cumulative delta divided by timeElapsed.
uint8 decimals local returned by IERC20(token).decimals().
uint256 assetValue local/return value of _calculate.
uint32 timeElapsed local in fetchPhnxPrice derived from lastTokenTimestamp and tokenToTimestampLast.

edges.reason: fetch refreshes values by calling setValues when the cumulative price is zero or the stored timestamp is older than three minutes, making control flow depend on block.timestamp.
fetchPhnxPrice calls setValues when PHNX cumulative price is zero or the timestamp is stale.
block.timestamp is read directly in the staleness condition of fetch.
block.timestamp is read directly in the staleness condition of fetchPhnxPrice.
setValues persists uint32(block.timestamp) into lastTokenTimestamp, propagating a manipulable timestamp into stored state.
setValues reads the factoryInterface storage reference.
setValues uses the WETH constant in the getPair call and address ordering.
setValues invokes the external getPair call on the factory.
setValues reads cumulative prices and reserves from the resolved pair.
setValues writes cummulativeAveragePrice[token].
setValues writes cummulativeEthPrice[token].
setValues writes tokenToTimestampLast[token].
setValues writes cummulativeAveragePriceReserve[token].
setValues writes cummulativeEthPriceReserve[token].
fetch delegates price extraction to _getAmounts for PHNX and the target token.
fetch reads cummulativeAveragePrice[token] in its staleness check.
fetch uses the PHNX constant as the denominator asset.
fetchPhnxPrice uses the PHNX constant for all lookups.
fetchPhnxPrice reads cummulativeEthPrice[PHNX].
fetchPhnxPrice reads cummulativeAveragePriceReserve[PHNX].
fetchPhnxPrice derives timeElapsed from timestamp mappings tokenToTimestampLast/lastTokenTimestamp.
fetchPhnxPrice calls _calculate to convert cumulative values into a price.
_getAmounts reads factoryInterface to resolve the pair.
_getAmounts uses the WETH constant in getPair.
_getAmounts invokes the external factory getPair call.
_getAmounts delegates the final computation to _calculate.
_getAmounts reads cummulativeAveragePrice[token].
_getAmounts reads cummulativeEthPriceReserve[token].
_getAmounts computes timeElapsed from tokenToTimestampLast and lastTokenTimestamp mappings.
_getAmounts reads lastTokenTimestamp[token] to derive elapsed time.
_calculate performs an external decimals() call on the supplied token.
_calculate divides the cumulative delta by timeElapsed, reverting or being undefined when timeElapsed is zero.
latestCommulative feeds the subtraction whose result is divided by timeElapsed.
oldCommulative feeds the subtraction whose result is divided by timeElapsed.
timeElapsed is the divisor; zero leads to division-by-zero revert and small values inflate the price.
token parameter is the target of the external decimals() call.
setValues token parameter is passed to factoryInterface.getPair.
_getAmounts token parameter is passed to factoryInterface.getPair.
